summary: Iteration 125 - Premium Differentiator Features (AI Weekly Digest, AI Upsell Engine, Competitor Rate Scraping) fully tested. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all components loading correctly, data displaying properly, and interactions working.

endpoints: GET /api/revenue/weekly-digest/{property_id} - Returns latest saved digest or 'none' status
POST /api/revenue/weekly-digest/{property_id}/generate - Generates AI digest using GPT-5.2
features: GPT-5.2 generates weekly revenue digest with 5 sections
Metrics: new_bookings, revenue, adr, avg_occupancy, room_nights, top_source, reviews, pending_reviews, price_alerts
Digest persisted to DB and retrievable

endpoints: GET /api/revenue/upsell/{booking_id} - Returns upsell suggestions with availability check
POST /api/revenue/upsell/{booking_id}/accept - Accepts upsell, adds to folio, logs to upsell_log
features: Room upgrades with real availability check
Add-ons: Breakfast (£15/night), Airport Transfer (£45/trip), Welcome Hamper (£35/stay), Parking (£12/night), Spa (£25/night)
Upsell acceptance adds charge to folio
Stats by type with count and revenue

endpoints: GET /api/revenue/rate-scraper/{property_id} - Returns competitor rate comparison table
POST /api/revenue/rate-scraper/{property_id}/apply - Applies suggested rates as overrides
features: Guard rails prevent excessive rate changes
Apply rates creates rate_overrides in DB

critical_code_review_comments: GPT-5.2 integration working correctly via Emergent LLM Key for weekly digest generation
Upsell engine correctly checks room availability before suggesting upgrades
Rate scraper has proper guard rails (max_adjustment_pct, min/max rate) to prevent extreme pricing
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 125 tested 3 premium differentiator features: 1) AI Weekly Digest (GPT-5.2 generates 5-section executive summary with metrics), 2) AI Upsell Engine (room upgrades with availability, early/late check-in/out, add-ons with Accept buttons), 3) Competitor Rate Scraping (14-day comparison table, config panel, apply rates). Navigation: Revenue Mgmt -> Intelligence section -> AI Weekly Digest or Rate Automation. Upsell tab: Calendar -> click booking bar -> Upsell tab. Weekly digest already generated and stored in DB.
